correctness.rationale: The proof derives the exact first-difference rule from binary carry propagation. Every length-3 reversible factor is forced to be palindromic. Every length-4 factor has one of two parity-controlled difference shapes, and negated reversal has neither shape when ell is at least 3. Any longer reflected factor would contain a reflected length-4 factor, so none exists. The packaged verifier independently stress-tests the arithmetic rule and factor behavior.
